title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
summary: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is an AI model that enhances robotic capabilities through advanced video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration. It enables robots to reason about complex real-world tasks, coordinate actions across multiple agents, and leverage tools effectively, marking a significant advancement in embodied AI and autonomous systems.
